basic_details.job_title: Zakir Husain Delhi College Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Zakir Husain Delhi College (University of Delhi) is filling 3 temporary project posts – 1 Project Associate-II and 2 Project Associate-I – in the NTPC-NETRA funded project "AI-Driven Robotic System for MSW Segregation (AI-SEG)", led by Dr. Manish Kumar, Principal Investigator, Department of Electronics. The monthly remuneration ranges from 25,000 + HRA to 35,000 + HRA, depending on the post and on whether the candidate has qualified NET, GATE or an equivalent national-level examination. The tenure is 2 months, extendable based on performance and project duration. Applications go by email to [e

how_to_apply: Save all three documents as soft copies in PDF format.
Email them to the Principal Investigator (PI), Dr. Manish Kumar, at [email protected].
Write the email subject as "Application for AI-SEG Project - [Position Name]", for example with Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II as the position name.
Send the email on or before 25 November 2026 up to 5 P.M.

rows.details: Zakir Husain Delhi College (University of Delhi)
AI-Driven Robotic System for MSW Segregation (AI-SEG)
2 Months (Extendable based on performance and project duration)
25,000 + HRA to 35,000 + HRA per month (varies by post and NET/GATE status)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives no category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Masters /Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University in Electronics/CS/Robotics, with proficiency in FANUC programming or ROS preferred. OR: 2 year experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc in Electronics/CS/IT. Knowledge of Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and Computer Vision is mandatory. OR: Any equivalent qualifications duly recognized by the concerned authority as per the functional requirement of the Project to be recorded in writing by PI and Director. The notice does not mention an age limit for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters /Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University in Electronics/CS/Robotics, OR 2 year experience in Research and Development (details below)
rows.preferred: Proficiency in FANUC programming or ROS

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc in Electronics/CS/IT, with knowledge of Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow and Computer Vision (mandatory), OR any equivalent qualification (details below)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay of each post depends on whether the candidate has qualified a national-level test. Rate (a) is for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET including lectureship / assistant professorship, or GATE, or national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. Rate (b) is for others who do not fall under (a). HRA is paid on top of the amounts shown; the notice does not state the HRA rate. The positions are temporary, with a tenure of 2 months, extendable based on performance and project duration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zakir Husain Delhi College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV. Write a cover letter. Scan your educational certificates. Save all three documents as soft copies in PDF format. Email them to the Principal Investigator (PI), Dr. Manish Kumar, at [email protected] . Write the email subject as "Application for AI-SEG Project - [Position Name]", for example with Project Associate-I or Project Associate-II as the position name. Send the email on or before 25 November 2026 up to 5 P.M. The notice's heading reads "Walk-in-Interview / Call for Applications", but it gives no interview date, time or venue; applications are invited by email. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Zakir Husain Delhi College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Project Associate-II and 2 Project Associate-I, all in the NTPC-NETRA funded AI-SEG project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 25 November 2026 up to 5 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Masters /Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University in Electronics/CS/Robotics (proficiency in FANUC programming or ROS preferred), OR 2 year experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc in Electronics/CS/IT with mandatory knowledge of Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow and Computer Vision, OR any equivalent qualification duly recognized by the concerned authority as per the project's functional requirement, recorded in writing by the PI and Director.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Project Associate in this project?
faq.answer: Project Associate-II gets 35,000 + HRA if NET/GATE or equivalent qualified, otherwise 28,000 + HRA; Project Associate-I gets 31,000 + HRA if NET/GATE or equivalent qualified, otherwise 25,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. Every pay rate in the notice is written as an amount "+ HRA", so HRA is added to the stated remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply and what should the email subject be?
faq.answer: Email your CV, cover letter and scanned educational certificates in PDF format to [email protected] with the subject "Application for AI-SEG Project - [Position Name]".

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are temporary project posts with a tenure of 2 months, extendable based on performance and project duration.
